purpose: Test whether a Ross-consistent mixed wet coordinate removes the B12/O13 WET_DRY interpolation failure before any full near-saturation face representation is reconsidered.

physical_scope.hydraulic_family: Staringreeks 2018 unimodal base MvG with KSATFIT, H_ENPR=0 and KSATEXM disabled
physical_scope.oracle: unchanged steady-Darcy integral/root law from E2A

fixed_dry_axis.reason: R0 showed p99 dry-only errors around 4e-5 for B12/O13 and no material improvement of the full error from Nu=241 to 961.

candidate_wet_axis.unsaturated_branch: uniform effective saturation S from S(h=-1 cm) to S=1, mapped back to h with the exact base-MvG inverse
candidate_wet_axis.saturated_branch: uniform pressure head h from 0 to +1 cm
candidate_wet_axis.shared_transition_node: h=0 cm appears once logically and is shared by both branches
candidate_wet_axis.persistent_state: pressure head remains canonical persistent state; S is lookup/worker coordinate only
candidate_wet_axis.selection_rule: smallest listed candidate passing every frozen metric for all four materials; no new density or coordinate may be introduced after execution

stored_face_quantity.interpolation: bilinear in binary64 after promoting four float32 logM nodes
stored_face_quantity.direct_M: not a candidate in R1A because R0 did not identify the log transform as dominant

probe_plan.distribution: wet branch sampled uniformly in physical h over [-1,+1], dry branch uniformly in u over [0,4]

required_diagnostics: max and p99 hybrid error per candidate and material
max absolute flux error over KSATFIT
worst probe including mixed wet branch, wet cell and dry cell
separate maxima for h<0 and h>=0 wet branches
candidate sparse-node count and conceptual full-table shared-memory formula
hard_guards: This is characterization, not qualification or production admission.
The E2A direct-head failure remains preserved.
No physical theta(h), K(h) or KSATFIT law is changed.
No Class-B H_ENPR/SVG2006 work is reopened.
No dry-axis retuning is allowed in this gate.
No threshold relaxation is allowed after seeing results.
A passing WET_DRY R1A permits only a separately frozen full-region R1B characterization.
